meta.siteDescription: Personal multi-domain subdomain directory, instant DNS studio, and live health monitor.

admin.envMissingDesc: Add ADMIN_PASSWORD and NAMECOM_USERNAME / NAMECOM_TOKEN in Vercel Environment Variables (or .env.local) to enable 1-click live DNS writes.
admin.signInDesc: Sign in to apply live DNS changes on Name.com or Cloudflare without opening a manual PR.

domains.noteNamecom: Primary dev domain managed via Name.com Core API
domains.noteNamecheap: Namecheap BasicDNS (copy helper + live DoH check, or switch NS to Cloudflare)

overview.heroSubtitle: Pick any of your available root domains, type a subdomain with instant suffix preview, copy exact CNAME / A / TXT records, or create DNS live in one click.
overview.heroMascotAlt: Chibi domain courier waving beside a tiny cloud-pup mascot
overview.cardLookupDesc: Filter by root domain, inspect live Name.com records, verify DoH, and copy targets.
overview.cardStudioDesc: Switch domains with dynamic .domain suffix, generate copyable rows, and apply DNS live.
overview.cardMonitorDesc: {live} live · {warn} warn · {dead} dead · provider API readiness check.
overview.emptyRegistryText: No subdomains tracked yet. Use Claim Subdomain to apply DNS live via API or generate copyable records.

directory.title: Multi-Domain Directory
directory.subtitle: Inspect registered subdomains across your root domains, verify live DNS via DoH, and copy records.
directory.mascotAlt: Cloud-pup mascot holding a magnifying glass
directory.noMatchDesc: Try another keyword or reset the domain/status filters.
directory.emptyDesc: Create your first subdomain in Claim Subdomain, or unlock Admin once Vercel env vars are configured to view Live DNS records.
directory.noGitFilesLiveBelow: No Git-tracked JSON files yet — live API records appear below.
directory.liveDescUnlocked: Admin mode unlocked: showing all live API records (protected apex/mail rows cannot be deleted here).
directory.liveDescLocked: Public preview shows safe non-reserved A/AAAA/CNAME endpoints (60s cache). Unlock Admin for full view and delete controls.
directory.emptyLiveRecords: No live API DNS records returned for this selection (or add NAMECOM_USERNAME / NAMECOM_TOKEN in Vercel Environment Variables).
directory.deleteDialogBody: This will immediately delete live record {type} {fqdn} → {value} from {domain}.
directory.deleteReservedConfirm: This is a reserved system label. Confirm deleting it permanently.
directory.liveLoadError: Unable to load live DNS records.

claim.title: Instant Subdomain Studio
claim.subtitle: Select one of your available root domains, enter a subdomain prefix, and apply DNS live or copy the generated rows.
claim.subdomainHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or dots (nested labels).
claim.reservedCheckboxText: Confirm applying reserved system label "{label}" on {domain}.
claim.presetVercelHint: In Vercel Project Settings → Domains, add your full subdomain first.
claim.presetGithubHint: Set custom domain in GitHub Repository → Settings → Pages.
claim.presetNetlifyHint: Add the custom domain in Netlify Site Configuration → Domain Management.
claim.presetVpsHint: Point directly to your server public IPv4 address.
claim.namecheapFooterText: Copy rows from panel 2 → paste into Domain List → Manage → Advanced DNS, then run DoH Verify.
claim.manualModeBadge: Manual Copy Mode Active · API Skipped
claim.autoApiUnlockedDesc: Admin unlocked — click below to write DNS directly without a PR.
claim.autoApiLockedDesc: Unlock Admin mode once to apply DNS live in one click.
claim.autoApiEnvMissingDesc: Set ADMIN_PASSWORD & registrar tokens on Vercel to enable 1-click writes.
claim.providerEnvMissingAction: Provider API Env Missing on Server
claim.dohHint: Click Verify Live DNS to query public Cloudflare/Google resolvers.
claim.dohNetworkError: Unable to reach DoH lookup endpoint.
claim.errLabelEmpty: Enter a subdomain label (e.g. blog, api, docs).
claim.errLabelInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or dots (no leading/trailing hyphen).
claim.errHardLockApex: Root apex (@) records are hard-locked to protect domain routing.
claim.errHardLockType: {type} records are managed directly at the DNS provider.
claim.errTargetCname: Enter a valid hostname without http:// or paths (e.g. cname.vercel-dns.com).
claim.errReservedConfirm: Check the confirmation box before applying reserved label "{label}".

health.title: Health, Quota & API Status
health.subtitle: Monitor registry probes, quota limits, and Vercel provider API readiness across all configured root domains.
health.serverEnvDesc: Boolean readiness checks only — API tokens stay strictly server-side in Vercel Env Vars.
health.envAdminDesc: Required to unlock live DNS mutations
health.envCloudflareDesc: Optional auto sync for Cloudflare zones
health.emptyProbeText: No Git-tracked JSON files in domains/ yet — provider API readiness above reflects your live deployment state.
